description: P3 consumer-assertion: the set of numbered checks in tools/policy_check.sh is pinned outside the checks themselves. Every check block opens with a `=== CHECK N: <title> ===` banner; this fixture extracts the `CHECK N` label of every `=== CHECK` banner (case-insensitive, any spacing after `===`, label ending at the first `:`, quote or `=`) and asserts it in equal mode against CHECK 1 through CHECK 18, each exactly once. Deleting a banner fails as missing; adding a banner for a new check without adding it here fails as an extra; a second banner reusing a number fails its occurrence count. Honest capability statement: the pin asserts that each banner line is present in tools/policy_check.sh, not that the block under it executes, still emits findings, or is reached at all; a check skipped by an early return, a guard, or a commented-out body with its banner left in place stays green. A new check authored without a `=== CHECK` banner is invisible to this pin. Canary blocks and the SAFETY, COMPAT, DISCOVERY and WORKFLOW-FIXTURES suites carry no `=== CHECK` banner and are not covered here; titles are not pinned, so retitling a check stays green.
